verdict.rationale: Datadog's Bits AI is documented as an AI assistant for the platform, and the official MCP server exposes telemetry to AI agents/tools, both of which plausibly support natural-language queries returning charts/data — but the evidence pack gives only a doc link/title for Bits AI with no detail on chart/query generation, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of this specific NL-to-query workflow. Missing for 10: detailed docs or examples showing natural-language input producing an actual query/chart, and independent/hands-on validation of this capability.
